# MatrixQR Digital Menu Generator

> Free, secure, client-side online tool that converts physical menu images or PDFs into scannable digital QR codes for restaurants, cafes, and bars.

## Core Features

- [Instant Image-to-QR](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, or PDF menu files (up to 10MB) into scannable QR codes instantly.
- [Secure Media Hosting](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): Uploaded menu files are hosted securely on fast Cloudflare R2 cloud storage; no personal tracking data is collected.
- [Client-Side Customization](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): Logo overlays and QR matrix styling are rendered entirely in the local browser Canvas.
- [Free & Frictionless](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): Unlimited usage with no user registration, payment, or account creation required.

## Clarification & Scope
- Note: This tool converts existing menu images/PDFs into QR access links. It is NOT an interactive online menu builder or text editor.
